أتعاظم (form VI)

# أَتَعَاظَمَ (ʔataʕāẓama) /ʔa.ta.ʕaː.ðˤa.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَعَاظَمَ (taʕāẓama)
# أَتَعَاظَمْ (ʔataʕāẓam) /ʔa.ta.ʕaː.ðˤam/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَعَاظَمَ (taʕāẓama)
